record.question: At the neuromuscular junction
options: The muscle membrane possesses muscarinic receptors
There is a one-to-one transmission of excitatory impulses from the motor neurone to the muscle fibres it innervates
The motor nerve endings secrete noradrenaline
The typical summed end plate potential (EPP) is usually 10 times the potential necessary to trigger an action potential
